## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:ADR-0149 D3 第 1 条下加一段只增不改的修订说明,写明「标签在每个语言下都是匹配目标」的准确含义:内联多语言标签的每个语言都算,翻译包里的标签只算为调用方语言解析出的那一个值(沿解析器的语言链:先按平台语言阶梯找请求语言,含变体扩展,再找部署声明的回退语言;请求语言即编写语言时跳过回退);别的语言的词只有写成同义词才命中。`dataset-term-matcher.ts` 的文档注释改成同样的话。没有任何代码行为变化。
- 为什么改:#34720 的裁决「A+C 本语言标签+同义词」(记录 6946563869)已定,但 ADR 原文和匹配器注释仍写「every locale」,读起来像翻译包的所有语言都能命中,与裁决和 HTTP 入口的实际行为不符。
- 风险与回滚:只改文档与注释,零运行时风险。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:① ADR-0149 D3 第 1 条下的修订说明,看是否如实转述裁决;② 其中「按传输层的调用方语言」一条:stdio 入口现在也走翻译(用 i18n 服务的默认语言),不是派发词所说的「不翻译」,见 Acceptance notes;③ `dataset-term-matcher.ts` 顶部注释。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm check:adr-symbol-anchors`,预期最后一行 `✅ check-adr-symbol-anchors: ... anchors across 158 records resolve`(修订说明里新增的符号锚都能解析)。
- 需要你做的:席位 L2 复核后,亲手合并本 PR(Tier H:`docs/adr/**`)。

## What changes

- **`docs/adr/0149-ai-answers-business-questions-through-the-dataset-semantic-layer.md`** (10 lines added, 0 removed): an add-only amendment note, nested under D3 rule 1 so the numbered list stays intact. It follows the record's existing amendment-note form (the #34761 note after rule 5) and its measurement discipline (symbol anchors only; the line positions are below, not in the record). It states:
  - an inline label map: every locale is a target, unless the bundle answers for that member;
  - a bundle label: one value, resolved for the caller's locale along the resolver's locale chain (option A; fix round 1 spells the chain out), resolved before matching; where the bundle answers, its value replaces the authored label (string or inline map), so the authored label is then no target, the consequence the ruling records;
  - a word in another language is an authored synonym (option C); `candidates` offer, never hit;
  - the caller's locale per transport: HTTP reads `Accept-Language`, falling back to the i18n default; stdio has no request and translates for the i18n service's default locale; with no resolvable i18n service the catalogue is untranslated on either;
  - the matcher is unchanged.
- **`packages/services/service-analytics/src/dataset-term-matcher.ts`** (doc comments only, +13 / -3): the module comment and the `MatchableMember.label` comment say the same words. No statement, type or export changes.

## Why

The decision text said a member's label matches "in every locale". The ruling on #34720, verbatim 「A+C 本语言标签+同义词」 (ruling record 6946563869), and the HTTP door hold it narrower. The note did not ride #34761's ADR note (PR #34828).

## Code readings behind each claim (base `ab441988`)

<details><summary>File and line positions, measured at the base commit</summary>

- HTTP door: `packages/runtime/src/domains/mcp.ts:1542` (`loadDatasets` inside `datasetToolMembers`) runs `translateMetaList` with `requestLocale` at `:1555` = `metaRequestLocale({ headers: context.request?.headers }, i18n)`. Headers only, so the locale is `Accept-Language`, else the i18n service's default.
- `packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-gate.ts:3208` `metaRequestLocale`: `Accept-Language`, then `?locale=`, then `i18n.getDefaultLocale()`. `:3538` `translateMetaList` returns the items untranslated when no locale resolves; `:3286` `metaTranslateOptions` adds the i18n fallback locale as the lookup chain.
- `packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts:1907` maps `dataset` to `translateDataset` (`:2626`); `translateDatasetMembers` (`:2545`, label lookup `:2562`) writes the bundle string over `member.label` when the bundle answers, an inline map included (the doc block's "An inline locale map is never changed" sentence: the catalog applies to it). `localeChain` (`:649`) is the caller's locale plus the fallback chain.
- Executor: `packages/services/service-analytics/src/dataset-tools.ts:365` loads through the transport's `loadDatasets`; `:439` hands the loaded (translated) members to `matchDatasetTerms`. The matcher (`dataset-term-matcher.ts`, `labelTargets`) reads a string or each value of an inline map and never reads a bundle.
- stdio: `packages/mcp/src/stdio-data-bridge.ts:1431`-`1458` runs the same `translateMetaList`, with `requestLocale` at `:1453` = `metaRequestLocale(undefined, i18n)`, the i18n service's default locale. This landed with #34833 (commit `6320abba`), the change made for card #34787.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **The dispatch's stdio premise did not hold at the base.** The dispatch said the stdio transport's `loadDatasets` applies no translation step. At `ab441988` it does: #34833 (`6320abba`) made it run the HTTP door's `translateMetaList` for the i18n service's default locale. The note states what the code does: on stdio the bundle label in the workspace default locale is a target, and an inline map's every locale is a target.
- **Bundle replaces, it does not add.** The ruling's words are "every locale of an inline label map, plus the bundle label in the caller's locale". In the code, a member that has both an inline map and a bundle entry for the caller's locale is served the bundle string alone. The note says so instead of implying both are targets for one member. This is the ruling's own recorded consequence (an English source label stops matching under a translated locale), stated one step more generally.
- **Overlap.** Open draft PR #34904 (#34763) touches `dataset-term-matcher.ts` too. `overlap-check` merges it cleanly with this branch.
- **Changeset: none, with the `skip-changeset` label.** The diff is an ADR (not published) plus doc comments in a published package. That is the fast lane's comment-only case, so nothing ships. An empty changeset was ruled out on purpose: `check-empty-changeset` refuses a new one.

## Fix round 1

Head `4b963c98` answers the seat's L2 record (comment 6954921504, S1, with N1 to N3 folded in) and the L1-c ACCEPT's note N1 (comment 6954336709), which made the same point as S1. Prose only: no statement, type or export changes. The body's What changes bullet and the 维护者速读 line above were edited to match.

- **S1, the bundle label's locale chain.** The note had said a bundle label matches in "the caller's locale only" and that "the bundle's values in other locales are not" targets. The resolver says otherwise. `lookupDatasetMemberAttr` walks `localeChain`: first the requested locale, read through `pickData` / `resolveBundleLocale` (exact, case, platform table language, base language, variant expansion), then the deployment's declared fallback locale. `metaTranslateOptions` supplies that fallback from `getFallbackLocale()`, and `localeChain` skips it when the caller's locale is the authored one (`getSourceLocale()`, else `getDefaultLocale()`). The note's bundle point now states that chain, says one value is served per member and only that value is a target, and replaces the clause with "no other bundle value is". It gives two worked cases. A `zh-TW` caller against a bundle whose only Chinese locale is `zh-CN` is served the `zh-CN` label: `resolveLocaleAmong` step 5, variant expansion. A `fr` caller in a deployment authored in another language, with declared fallback `en`, is served the `en` label when the bundle has no French one. The bold lead now reads "the one translation-bundle label resolved for the caller's locale". New anchors: `i18n-resolver.ts#lookupDatasetMemberAttr`, `i18n-resolver.ts#resolveBundleLocale`, `meta-item-read-gate.ts#metaTranslateOptions`. The matcher's module comment mirrors the chain in one clause, and its `MatchableMember.label` comment says "resolved for", not "resolved to".
- **N1, the HTTP pair-translation corner.** When no i18n service resolves, stdio has no locale (`metaRequestLocale(undefined, undefined)` is `undefined`), so `translateMetaList` returns the items untranslated. HTTP is different: `Accept-Language` still yields a locale, and `pairTranslationBundleOf` reads a declared override's pair bundle from the protocol. `translateDataset` then applies it through `labelCatalogs`. The note now names that one exception (anchor `meta-item-read-gate.ts#pairTranslationBundleOf`).
- **N2, other doors.** The note adds one sentence. Any other door to the same executor, cloud's service-ai `ToolRegistry` (D2) among them, supplies the executor's `loadDatasets` itself and owes the same translation step. The contract it points to is `dataset-tools.ts#DatasetToolsDeps`, whose `loadDatasets` doc already says "localized at the metadata boundary for the caller's locale". No repository beyond those the ADR already names is cited.
- **N3, the PR in the note header.** The header now says "PR #34928" instead of "this PR". That is ADR-0011's note form, minus the commit, which does not exist before merge.
